archaeologist.description:
ARCHAEOLOGIST—DELVING INTO ANTIQUITY

At a Glance

The Archaeologist is an action hero that spelunks, discovers that which was lost, and overall excels in the fringes and lost spaces of the Galaxy. Indiana Jones to a T.

All-in or Hybrid?

Hybrid 1/2 Knowledge Character, 1/2 "Indiana Jones / Aphra Adventurer"

What Should it be the Best At?

Interacting with Old Stuff (and Technology) and places

What should it be just “good” at?

Rough & Tumble

Using knowledge for general utility

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Sage or Analyst in that is combines Knowledge skills & some other niche

Scholar

Fringer

Media Touchstones

Indiana Jones

Chelli Aphra (Marvel Comics Star Wars)

Dr. Liara T'Soni (Mass Effect)

Updated 12/10/2025

assassin.description:
ASSASSIN — INSTRUMENT OF POLICY

At a Glance

Contract Killer, Killer most important

Infiltration and Stealth a must

Lethality & Critting to Death

All-in or Hybrid?

75%Combat 25%Stealth/Infiltration

What Should it be the Best At?

Lethality & Critting to Death

Super-Sentient Feats of Excellence

What should it be just “good” at?

Sniping

Melee

Stealth

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Sharpshooter

Infiltrator

Executioner

Makashi Duelist

Media Touchstones

Fennec Shand (The Mandalorian)

IG-88 (Episode V: Empire Strikes Back)

Garrus Vakarian (Mass Effect 2/3)

Legion (Mass Effect 2/3)

Zam Wessel (Episode II: Attack of the Clones)

updated 12/10/2025

big_game_hunter.description:
BIG-GAME HUNTER—KILLS BEASTS, WILL TRAVEL

At a Glance

The Big Game Hunter is a hunter of beasts and master of their environment, and are exceptional marksman, and serves as useful guides in survival situations.

All-in or Hybrid?

2/3 Beast-Related Combat, 1/3 Survivalism & Related Utility

What Should it be the Best At?

Killing Big and Dangerous Creatures

What should it be just “good” at?

Sniping and Ranged Heavy Marksmanship

Survivalism

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Hunter

Scholar

Survivalist

Media Touchstones

Qyzen Fess (Star Wars: The Old Republic)

Updated 12/10/2025

blockade_runner.name: Blockade Runner
blockade_runner.description:
At a Glance

The Blockade runner is the pilot that can outrun anything, avoid detection, and generally makes it impossible to be pinned down, or worse, impounded.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Generic, defensive-leaning Pilot, ¼ Navigator w/ a Focus on Obfuscation, and ¼ Convincing authorities things are “above board”

What Should it be the Best At?

Piloting Defensively

What should it be just “good” at?

Astrogation, 
Social

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Pilot (Raw),
Navigator,
Ship Captain

Media Touchstones

Han Solo

Kay Vess (Star Wars Outlaws)

Booster Terrik

Hoban “Wash” Washbourne  (Firefly)

bodyguard.description:
BODYGUARD—SECURING THE VIP

At a Glance

The Bodyguard is the perfect chauffeur or personal protector, often both.

All-in or Hybrid?

 Hybrid. ⅛ Offensive capability, ⅛ Perception-based Utility, ½ Defensive & Protective Capability, 1/4 defensive driving

What Should it be the Best At?

Bodyguarding

What should it be just “good” at?

Ranged Combat

Piloting (Planetary), specifically Defensive Driving

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Vanguard(sub out raw tank & Damage for attack mitigation and driving)

Heavy(for the amount of Sidestep)

Gunner

Media Touchstones

Marcus Cole (Babylon5)

Ta’Lon (Babylon 5)

John Wick

updated 12/11/2025

charmer.description:
At a Glance

The Charmer is the faciest face that ever face’d. They are a the perfect embodiment of a character that uses their looks, charm, suaveness to grease every wheel in the galaxy.

All-in or Hybrid?

All-in on the positive aspects of sociality. Maybe ⅔ Charm, ⅓ Deception and Negotiation, max.

What Should it be the Best At?

Charm, obviously

Avoiding consequences (social or otherwise) due to being so socially magnetic

Buffing Debuffing in a very bard-y way

What should it be just “good” at?

Deception

Negotiation

Other Smuggler stuff

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Diplomat

Republic Representative

Politico

Performer

Media Touchstones

Lando “Balthazar” Calrissian

Saffron (Firefly)

Mr. Morden (Babylon 5)

updated 12/11/2025

cyber_tech.description:
CYBER TECH—IMPROVING ON ORGANIC

At a Glance

The cyberneticist is an interesting combination of healer and technician, usually culminating in a self-sufficient, highly specialized fusion of sentient and durasteel.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅖ Cybernetics and crafting-oriented tech, ⅖ Individual cybernetics and superiority, ⅕ Medicine and Surgery

What Should it be the Best At?

Crafting Cybernetics

Installing Cybernetics

Wielding Cybernetics

Super-Sentient Feats of Excellence

What should it be just “good” at?

Medicine

General Tech

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Shipwright(Focus on Crafting, but less all-in than the Shipwright happens to be)

Alchemist(Medical-focused crafting spec, with a rough split between crafting and medicine. Pretty analogous)

Modder(Strangely, it feels similar because the Cyber builds one thing, usually themselves, into a weapon to surpass metal gear. Much like the modder does a gun or their whip)

Media Touchstones

Thundercat (Book of Boba Fett)

Cornelius Evazan from Mos Eisley (and at least 12 other systems) (Episode IV: A New Hope)

Viktor Vector (Cyberpunk 2077)

Updated 12/10/2025

demolitionist.description:
DEMOLITIONIST - NEVER STOP BLOWING UP

At a Glance

The Demolitionist is the specialist - the safecracker, the trapmaker, the walking stick of dynamite. They often fulfil technical roles on the team, but whatever they do, they do it with a bang.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅘  Explosives and associated Utility, ⅕ unrelated technical utilityBR]
What Should it be the Best At?

Explosives as a Tool, Explosives as Weapons

What should it be just “good” at?

Skullduggery

Mechanics

Technical Tasks

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Sapper

Heavy

Saboteur

Media Touchstones

Heist Movie Safecrackers

Ank Parako (Star Wars Outlaws)

Bomb Voyage (The Incredibles)

Vinny Santorini (Atlantis: The Lost Empire)

The Evil Midnight Bomber What Bombs at Midnight (The Tick)

Updated 12/10/2025

doctor.description:
DOCTOR—DO NO HARM

At a Glance

Doctors are the masters of conventional Medicine and healing. They also represent an education, sophistication, and moral purity that is lost on most in the outer reaches and in the underworld.

All-in or Hybrid?

 1/2 Healing, 1/8 Buffing, 3/8 General Non-Combat & Knowledge Utility

What Should it be the Best At?

Raw Healing Output

Healing In Proper Medical Environments

What should it be just “good” at?

Battlefield Medicine

Incentivizing Peaceful Solutions

Knowledge-Based Utility

Medical-Based Buffs

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Medic(Should be better at critical injury management, and emergency stim usage, and combat).

Healer(Should be better at holistic healing, and Force protection. Probably the closest thing to a side grade to doctor).

Alchemist(Should be better at making medicine, obviously with Force influence, but worse at raw healing).

Media Touchstones

Simon Tam (Firefly)

Leonard McCoy (Star Trek)

Dr. Franklin (Babylon 5)
 
Julian Bashir (Star Trek: Deep Space 9)

“Doc” Kimble (Star Wars: The Old Republic)

Updated 12/11/2025

driver.description:
DRIVER—PEDAL TO THE METAL

At a Glance

The driver is, bar-none, the best of the best while driving planetary vehicles of all stripes, especially off-road and in dangerous areas.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅔ Hybrid, mostly engaging with being an excellent planetary pilot, ⅓ with associated vehicle-based Utility like mechanics.

What Should it be the Best At?

Driving, Especially Off-Road

What should it be just “good” at?

Piloting

Mechanics

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Racer
Pilot

Rigger

Media Touchstones

Mad Max/Furiosa

Young Han Solo (circa Solo: A Star Wars Story)

Updated 12/10/2025

droid_tech.description:
At a Glance

The Droid Tech is the ultimate minion master in the game, focusing exclusively on building, repairing, improving, and leading a small squad of droids to fill rolls in the party or be an effective combat force

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Droid Crafter
½ Droid Leader

What Should it be the Best At?

Building Droids

Leading Droids

What should it be just “good” at?

General Mechanics

Computers

General Leadership

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Droid Specialist (Spec is much more focused on breaking and repairing droids, but less focused on crafting and leadership)

Hermit (Really just in the minion Mastery, but also the healing and holistic support of the minion)

Separatist Commander (does care more about leadership and specifically Droid leadership, but nothing about Droid creation or repair)

Media Touchstones

Gauge (Borderlands 2)

Anakin Skywalker (circa Episode I: The Phantom Menace)

Babu Frik (Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker)

Entrapta (She-Ra)

Updated 12/10/2025

enforcer.description:
ENFORCER - BREAKING KNEES, TAKING NAMES

At a Glance

The Enforcer is the Thug’s idea of a face-character. Thinly-veiled threats, dire ultimatums, and a willingness to follow through. This character is the master of maneuvering the criminal underworld, and applying the right kind of leverage for the desired result.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅖  Coercion-focussed sociality and being scary, ⅖ Streetwise and Problem-solving, ⅕ Combat

What Should it be the Best At?

Coercion and Intimidation

What should it be just “good” at?

Underworld Maneuvering

Melee & Brawl Combat

Being Tough

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Aggressor(Largely very similar trees, but Aggressor is more about how to use fear as an offensive weapon. Enforcer would be more utility-focussed.)

Skip Tracer(Comparable in that they have a light combat sub-focus in combat-focussed careers, with a heavy focus on underworld maneuvering.)

Marshal(The closest in terms of tree split; they both care about sociality, streetwise, and a form of nonlethal combat.)

Warden(More of a Martial Artist, but it does have the Fear-based Battlefield control.)

Media Touchstones

Sevika (Arcane Season 1)

Al Neri (Godfather)

Fennec Shand (Book of Boba Fett)

Updated 12/10/2025

entrepreneur.description:
ENTREPRENEUR—SECURING THE PURSE

At a Glance

The entrepreneur is a shrewd and competent business-person, using money to make money and solve problems.

All-in or Hybrid?

 Hybrid ⅓ Making Money, ⅓ Credits-Related Social Utility, ⅙ Credit-Related General Utility, ⅙  General Utility

What Should it be the Best At?

Making Money

Using Money to Solve Problems

What should it be just “good” at?

Trading

Positive Sociality

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Trader

Republic Representative

Arbiter

Media Touchstones

Davo Sculdun (Andor)

Luthen Rael (Andor)

Lando Calrissian (Episode V:Empire Strikes Back)

field_agent.name: Field Agent
field_agent.description: The field agent is the jack-of-all-trades spy that operates in the field, often sent to investigate and infiltrate a situation socially. While a decent combatant, they mostly talk their way out of problems and resort to fisticuffs and light concealable weapons.

fringer.description:
FRINGER—DISCOVER POSSIBILITIES

At a Glance

The Fringer is an odd duck of “knowing where to be and knowing where not to be”. Find the way, and the way out. That translates to solid piloting, good negotiating and “fixing,” good at getting out of the way when the blaster bolts start flying.

All-in or Hybrid?

Super Hybrid, likely a 1/4 Generic Danger avoidance, 1/4 Astro & Spaceflight, 1/4 Social Navigation, ¼ Literal Generalism

What Should it be the Best At?

Avoiding the dangers of being on the fringe

What should it be just “good” at?

Piloting

Astrogating

Underworld-flavored Negotiations

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Trader

Navigator

Media Touchstones

Mad Max/Furiosa

Luke Skywalker (circa Episode IV: A New Hope)

Updated 12/10/2025

gadgeteer.description:
GADGETEER—CONNOISSEUR OF TECH

At a Glance

Gadgeteers are masters of weapons and equipment used in the process of tracking, capturing, and eliminating their targets.

All-in or Hybrid?

40% Weapon-agnostic Combat, 40% technologist, 20% imposing figure

What Should it be the Best At?

Using a wide variety of weapons and excelling equally with all of them

Making on-the-fly adjustment to armament.

What should it be just “good” at?

Being Imposing

General Mechanics

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Outlaw Tech

Modder

Armorer

[I[Enforcer

Vanguard

Media Touchstones

Boba Fett (Episode V: Empire Strikes Back)

Cad Bane (The Clone Wars)

Din Djarin (The Mandalorian)

Jango Fett (Episode II: Attack of the Clones)

gambler.description:
At a Glance

The Gambler is the risk-taker, the card-shark, the character in any group that’s willing to put it all on red for a big win.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Generic gambling-related dice futzing, ½ actual gambler, slight of hand, and deceptive elements

What Should it be the Best At?

Deception and Sleight of Hand

Gambling

Going Big and paying off (not in Ships)

What should it be just “good” at?
 
Computers

Initiative/Cool

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Thief (Mostly the sleight of hand stuff)

Scoundrel (generic Smuggler stuff)

Hotshot (pushing your luck mechanics)

Media Touchstones

Lando Calrissian

James Bond (Casino Royale)

gunslinger.description:
GUNSLINGER—DOUBLE-TAP

At a Glance

The most skilled small-arms combatants. The fastest draw, the deadest shot. They can take down an army of sleemos before they can even blink.

All-in or Hybrid?

¾ Ranged Light and “Small Arms Efficacy”, ⅛Outlaw Vibes, ⅛ Initiative Monkey skills”

What Should it be the Best At?

Ranged Light

Two-Weapon Fighting

What should it be just “good” at?

Initiative

Being Intimidating

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Marshall(They are mirrors of one another. Marshall is an off-face that can shoot. Gunslinger is a killer who looks mean)

Warleader(Only share overlap in their ranged light focus, but aren’t “damage” oriented)

Death Watch Warrior(Less focused on movement, but they will have a similar emphasis on death-dealing)

Bodyguard(Mostly worried about protection and retaliation, but a similar focus on one-handed weapons)

Media Touchstones

Cobb Vanth (The Mandalorian)

Tobias Beckett (Solo: A Star Wars Story)

Cad Bane

Zoe Washburne (Firefly)

Updated 12/10/2025

heavy.description:
HEAVY - WALL OF MEAT AND BULLETS

At a Glance

The Heavy lays down the heavy fire, heavy armament, and does it while being a veritable wall of meat.

They are by far, the highest raw damage output of all Hired Guns, but probably every.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Tank, ½ Spank. Very little utility outside of that.

What Should it be the Best At?

Using heavy weaponry (mostly blasters)

Carrying Heavy Things

Soaking Damage

What should it be just “good” at?

Ship-based Combat

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Gunner(Less about taking out ships larger than their own/whittling them down. More about generic firepower superiority.)

Rigger(Applies personal tankiness, rather than shipboard tankiness)

Vanguard(More about being an unmoving personal mortar than a “stick and move” dodge tank.)

Media Touchstones

CT-782 “Hevy” (The Clone Wars)

Paz Vizsla (The Mandalorian)

Baze Malbus (Rogue One)

Wrecker (The Bad Batch)

Wrex (Mass Effect)

Updated 12/10/2025

marauder.description:
MARAUDER - LIVING BEAT STICK

At a Glance

The Marauder is the master of hand to hand combat, king of killing, dishes out pain and shrugs it off in turn. If Star Wars has a Barbarian, it would be the Marauder.

All-in or Hybrid?

4/5 Beats, 1/5 any other utility.

What Should it be the Best At?

Beating face, and shrugging off damage

Actively killing and incapacitating

What should it be just “good” at?

Any specific kind of combat

Survival

Coercion

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Colossus(Utilizing some of the survivability tools without going that hard on being literally unkillable.)

Shi-cho Knight(Pulling from some of the “generalist fighter” aspects.)

Executioner(Executioner)

Media Touchstones

Black Krrsantan (Book of Boba Fett)

Drax (Guardians of the Galaxy)

Rama (The Raid 2)

Grog (Vox Machina)

Updated 12/10/2025

marshal.description:
MARSHAL—FRONTIER JUSTICE

At a Glance

This character is the steely-nerved lawman, whether that be official or unofficial. They lay down the law with inspiring leadership, imposing stature and reputation, and most importantly, the blaster at their hip.

All-in or Hybrid?

Three-way hybrid - Coercion and Leadership-focused sociality, Criminal-interaction, and ranged light shoot-em-ups

What Should it be the Best At?

Transitioning from Combat to Social encounters. 

Non-Lethal Takedowns

What should it be just “good” at?

Ranged Light

Coercion

Criminal Element Interaction

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Gunslinger

Warden

Enforcer

Media Touchstones

Cobb Vanth (Book of Boba Fett)

Jacobi Sterne (SWRPG - Far Horizons)

IG-11 (The Mandalorian)

Michael Girabaldi (Babylon 5)

Mulan (Li Shang)

updated 12/11/2025

martial_artist.description:
MARTIAL ARTIST - UNARMED AND DANGEROUS

At a Glance

A martial artist should be the master of both attack and defense, and movement while unarmed. They are defined by supreme grace and athleticism, and sheer force of will.

All-in or Hybrid?

66% Unarmed Combat 34% Martial Utility

What Should it be the Best At?

Unarmed Attacks, Crits, unarmed parrying

What should it be just “good” at?

Swift Movement

Physical and Mental Defenses

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Steel Hand Adept

Warden

Marauder

Colossus

Media Touchstones

Qi’ra (Solo: Star Wars Story)

Arden Lyn (Masters of Teras Kasi)

Embo (The Clone Wars)

Spike Spiegel (Cowboy Bebop)

mechanic.description:
MECHANIC—Mr. Fix-it

At a Glance

The default technical generalist in the setting, the mechanic equal parts cobbler, ship doctor, and technical problem solver.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Mechanics Problem Solver & Generalist, ½ Ship Doctoring

What Should it be the Best At?

Broad-Spectrum Mechanic-ing

Ship Damage Repair

What should it be just “good” at?

Crafting

Piloting

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Rigger

Modder

Artisan

Media Touchstones

Anakin Skywalker (circa Episode I: The Phantom Menace)

Chewbacca

Peli Motta (The Mandalorian)

Updated 12/10/2025

mercenary_soldier.description:
MERCENARY SOLDIER - DIRTY DEEDS DONE DIRT CHEAP

At a Glance

The Mercenary Soldier is the leadership-oriented hired gun, the head of a merc band, or the tactical lead on a covert op. They are extremely effective combatants, and even better at managing small-scale skirmishes.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Leadership, ½ Ranged Combat

What Should it be the Best At?

Leading bands of “irregulars”

What should it be just “good” at?

Ranged Combat

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Commando
Warleader
Tactician
Clone Lieutenant
Clone Soldier
Retired Clone Trooper
Media Touchstones

Barney Ross (The Expendables)

CT-9901 “Hunter” (The Bad Batch)

Rick Flag Sr (Creature Commandos)

Zaeed Massani (Mass Effect)

updated 12/11/2025

modder.description:
MODDER—I Rewired It

At a Glance

The Modder is a gear optimizer to the nth degree. They are a force multiplier for anyone with a ship or a gun.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅔ Modding and Managing Gear, ⅓ Signature Vehicle stuff

What Should it be the Best At?

Modding Weapons and min maxing their potential

Modding Vehicles

What should it be just “good” at?

Crafting

General Mechanics

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Outlaw Tech(Modder is much more a pure mechanic speed, whereas the the OT is a bit more of a half-tech, half scum tree)

Artisan(Artisan really is a generic ship doctor with a couple elements of increasing hard points and some crafting bits. Modder is all in on well…missing)

Scavenger (Scavenger is kind of what Outlaw spec should have been, minus the scavenger bits, but it has some overlap with modder by pushing the minmax vibe)

Rigger(Rigger is more defensive and passive in how it interacts with the signature vehicle, also more all-in on Sig vehicle. Modder is split between vehicle and gunplay)

Media Touchstones

Updated 12/10/2025

nerf_herder.name: Nerf Herder
nerf_herder.description: The Nerf herder is the animal husbandry maximalist, and the outdoors person who can shepherd a flock of animals in the most inhospitable situations.

operator.description:
OPERATOR—RIDE ‘EM DOWN, BRING ‘EM IN

At a Glance

Operators are the masters of the vehicle-based, non-lethal takedowns. They track their targets, both on land and in space, ride them down, disable their vehicles, and take them in for a bounty.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅕ Tracking & Navigation, ⅖ Piloting, and ⅖ nonlethal gunnery.

What Should it be the Best At?

Nonlethal ship combat, disabling ships.

What should it be just “good” at?

Flying Ships, especially in rough terrain

Astronavigation, Navigation

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Rigger

Pilot

Racer

Navigator

Media Touchstones

Jango Fett (Episode II: Attack of the Clones)

outlaw_tech.description:
OUTLAW TECH

At a Glance

In a shell nut, the Outlaw Tech is a jack of all technical prowess, with a focus on shady or otherwise dangerous aftermarket modifications, and it's very adept at navigating the criminal underworld to get them.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅓ Tech generalist, ⅓ “Dangerous Improvement", ⅓ Underworld Fixing

What Should it be the Best At?

Pushing weapons and gear in unexpected directions, often dangerously directions

Securing Materials and equipment for these illegal and nefarious purposes

What should it be just “good” at?

Mechanics, generally

Underworld fixing

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Scoundrel(Has a bit of the underworld fixxer in common, but otherwise kind of the the generalist vibe)

Mechanic(Both have significant overlap in terms of mechanic generalist, but mechanic cares more about ship-based stuff))

Scavenger (Cares about pushing stuff to their limit, but unlike the OT, cares about “stuff being broken” and that being a core of the gameplay loop)

Media Touchstones

Jinx (League of Legends: Arcane)

Tali'Zorah vas Normandy (Mass Effect)

MacGyver (MacGyver)

B.A. Baracus (The A-Team)

Updated 12/10/2025

performer.description:
PERFORMER—MAKING THEM NOTICE

At a Glance

A Performer is a character that seeks the center of every room, is good at getting all eyes on them, and has the social graces and physical fitness to put on a good show!

All-in or Hybrid?

2-1 Hybrid; “Social Crowd Control” and Melee Supportive Fighter

What Should it be the Best At?

Debuffing Enemies in social and combat situations

Utilizing the powers of stardom, performance, etc to their ends

What should it be just “good” at?

Melee Combat, specifically Dueling

Buffing Allies

Being Hard to Hit

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Politico

Advocate

Makashi Duelist

Media Touchstones

Sy Snoodles (Episodes VI: Return Of The Jedi)

Joh Yowza (Episodes VI: Return Of The Jedi)

Inara (Firefly)

updated 12/11/2025

politico.description:
POLITICO—THE BIGGER FISH

At a Glance

The Politico is a social everyman, able to explore all the avenues of being a “public figure,” whether they are a true-blue local politician, a fixer, a crime boss with a public face.

All-in or Hybrid?

75% Social, 25% social-adjacent Utility

What Should it be the Best At?

Covering the full spectrum of sociality

What should it be just “good” at?

Any one Social

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Prophet

Advisor

Senator

Media Touchstones

Bib Fortuna (Episode VI: Return of the Jedi)

Greef Karga (The Mandalorian)

Mok Shaiz (The Book of Boba Fett)

scholar.description:
SCHOLAR—THE GIFT OF KNOWLEDGE

At a Glance

The Scholar turns knowing things into doing things, understand enough broad subject matter to help their colleagues during difficult situations, and comes in clutch with a valuable factoid.

All-in or Hybrid?

All-in on Knowledge

Slight niche concerning being good at learning

Slight niche concerning noticing things

What Should it be the Best At?

Knowing things and leveraging that into general utility & support

What should it be just “good” at?

Learning New Things

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Doctor (No Real overlap aside from subject matter expertise, and Voice of Reason)

[IScientist (All in on Intelligence, but split between knowledge and mechanics)

Sage(Knowledge and Force Powers split)

Media Touchstones

Eno Cordova (Jedi Survivor)

Jocasta Nu (Episode II: Attack of the Clones)

Lor San Tekka (Episode VII: The Force Awakens)

scoundrel.description:
SCOUNDREL—TALK YOURSELF IN AND OUT OF TROUBLE

At a Glance

The scoundrel is the quick-witted conman, borrowing from Chewie to pay Han. Always working a deal, abandoning it in a flash when it all goes south. Often utilising deception as a means (although maybe not always successfully). When the chips are down, will scrap for their freedom.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Deception focused 1/4 Ranged Light combatant (single weapon only), 1/4 Cool/Initiative

What Should it be the Best At?

Deceiving and con jobs.

Getting out of trouble.

What should it be just “good” at?

Single pistol Ranged Light weapons.

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Gunslinger(The Scoundrel is very much a watered down and catch all spec for most of what the other more specialized specs do for Smuggler)

Thief(Barely any overlap, aside from incidental caring about Deception)

Charmer(Less so part of the Scoundrels repertoire but there should be a small element of charm to the scruffy looking nerf-herder)

Death Watch Warrior(Less focused on movement, but they will have a similar emphasis on death-dealing)

Pirate(The pirate is the Scoundrel who has an entire crew at their disposal to pillage what they desire, although more overt than the scoundrel)

Performer(Some distraction and deception elements)

Media Touchstones

Han Solo

Jod Na Nawood (Skeleton Crew)

Malcolm Reynolds (Firefly)

Jack Sparrow (Pirates of the Caribbean)

Eddy (Ed, Edd, & Eddy)

Updated 12/10/2025

scout.description:
SCOUT - BLAZING THE TRAIL

At a Glance

The scout is the perfect “roughing it" support specialization, acting as a Chiss Army Knife in those situations, assisting their allies in a number of way out in the wild.

All-in or Hybrid?

Hybrid, probably 3-way between active scouting and naturalism, and role-filling in the party.

What Should it be the Best At?

Surviving and Traversing the wilderness

Actually Scouting

Initiative Support

What should it be just “good” at?

Athleticism

Piloting Planetary

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Pathfinder

Navigator

Survivalist

Media Touchstones

Mad Max/Furiosa

Rey (circa Episode VII: The Force Awakens)

Updated 12/10/2025

skip_tracer.description:
SKIP TRACER—GIVING THEM A CHOICE

At a Glance

Skip Tracers are the masters of getting to the target using a variety of social tools, contacts, and underhandedness. And once they’ve found them, negotiate paying off their bounty, or to come in quietly.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Underworld and skulduggery nonsense (the tracking), ¼ Combat Prowess, ¼ Negotiating.

What Should it be the Best At?

Leveraging Information and People in the seedier parts of society to get their mark.

What should it be just “good” at?

Being ready for danger and good at being the danger

General Negotiation

Breaking & Entering

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Investigator

Marshal

Interrogator

Scoundrel

Media Touchstones

Din Djarin (The Mandalorian)

Faye Valentine (Cowboy Bebop)

Greedo (Episode IV: A New Hope)

slicer.description:
SLICER

At a Glance

Slicer is the quintessential hacker. They infiltrate the analogue computer systems of Star Wars the way a thief picks a lock, and if thy're lucky, get away unnoticed.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅔ Slicing & Computers, ⅙ General Stealth, and ⅙ Underworld Stuff

What Should it be the Best At?

Slicing & Computers

What should it be just “good” at?

Stealth

Underworld fixing

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Strategist(More of a military analyst than an aggressive slicer, but cyber-warfare is)

Analyst(The analyst plays more into the helpful support archetype, and the slicing is more of a sub niche))

Media Touchstones

D.J. (Episode XIII: The Last Jedi)

Conder Nash (Star Wars Aftermath: Life Debt)

Updated 12/10/2025

survivalist.description:
SURVIVALIST—MASTER OF THE WILD

At a Glance

A rugged, self sufficient, primal Hunter and killer of sentients. Good at going for the throat when the opportunity presents itself.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Rugged Outlander & Survivalist ½ Hunter and Killer.

What Should it be the Best At?

Tracking Sentients and Killing Them

What should it be just “good” at?

Being fairly hardy and hard to land meaningful hits on

Using knowledge and craftiness to become stronger

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Big Game Hunter

Trailblazer

Media Touchstones

Zuckuss (Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back)

John Rambo (Rambo: First Blood)

Daryl Dixon (The Walking Dead)

updated 12/10/2025

thief.description:
At a Glance

This is the smuggler who is most at home in the shadows, taking what he needs as he needs it. Able to get in and get out without anyone knowing they were there.

All-in or Hybrid?

2/5 Stealth, 2/5 Stealing & Sleight of Hand, 1/5 Selling off or ‘fencing’ their stolen goods

What Should it be the Best At?

Stealth

Pickpocketing and Stealing goods

Entry and Exit

What should it be just “good” at?

Selling off goods that are stolen. They mostly get the goods.

Underhanded Combat, they prefer to cut and run rather than fight.

Disruption of Security

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Courier (The courier is the spy version of the thief, more oriented towards athleticism)

Scavenger (Like the thief, they gain things to be sold)

Assassin (Get in, do your thing, get out)

Media Touchstones

Kay Vess (Star Wars Outlaws)

Ezra Bridger (circa Star Wars Rebels)

Garret (Thief)

Robin Hood

Aladdin

Gambit (X-Men)

trader.description:
TRADER—THE ART OF THE DEAL

At a Glance

The Trader is the consummate communicator and pitch-man. They can make a deal as easily as they can breathe.They are Shrewd, capable, and a little bit untrustworthy.

All-in or Hybrid?

Hybrid, ⅓ general utility related to criminality and “knowing people” being well-traveled, and ⅔ about trading and salesmanship, extending that to more general utility.

What Should it be the Best At?

Trading, especially physical goods

What should it be just “good” at?

General Negotiating

Underworld Maneuvering

Social Defense

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Entrepreneur

Scavenger

Media Touchstones

Badger (Firefly)

Watto (TPM)

Quark (DS9)

Updated 12/10/2025
